description: This file contains unit tests for the AssistantTextParser's segment parsing functions, testing handling of tags, segment visibility, and content filtering.

classes.name: AssistantTextParserTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests verifying the behavior of AssistantTextParser's segment parsing functions.

methods.name: splitsThinkAndFinalSegments
methods.description: Tests parsing segments with <think> and <final> tags, verifying correct segment detection and content extraction.

methods.name: keepsTextWithoutTags
methods.description: Tests parsing when there are no tags, expecting a single response segment with the full text.

methods.name: ignoresThinkingLikeTags
methods.description: Ensures that tags similar to <thinking> are ignored and treated as plain text.

methods.name: dropsEmptyTaggedContent
methods.description: Tests that empty <think> tags result in no segments being produced.

methods.name: hidesThinkingSegmentsFromVisibleOutput
methods.description: Verifies that <think> segments are excluded from visible output segments.

methods.name: thinkingOnlyTextIsNotVisibleByDefault
methods.description: Checks default behavior for the presence of visible content when only <think> tags are present.
